raw: {"analysis": "Both responses provide solid migration plans, but MBB is more thorough in addressing key constraints: it explicitly notes the shared crypto library cannot be modified without finance approval, includes a mock integration harness to validate partners locally before the restricted staging window, and details a safer merge order (parser first) to preserve backward compatibility. PFW covers similar steps but is less specific on the shared library constraint, lacks a pre-staging validation harness, and treats dispatcher and parser changes as a single atomic unit, which could increase risk. MBB also offers a more granular rollout (internal 5% before partners) and a more actionable rollback procedure with coordination, reducing the need for follow-up questions.", "verdict": "MBB"}
